title: IG-88
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: IG series assassin droids were feared throughout the galaxy, thanks to memories of the clankers of the Clone Wars fresh in the minds of many throughout the galaxy. IG-88 was a particularly feared bounty hunter and assassin. He answered Darth Vader's call to the bridge of his Super Star Destroyer, given the task to hunt down Han Solo and the Millennium Falcon after it disappeared.
